chemistry-killer-06.material:
Imida yotshintsho lwemibala yee-indicator yile:
Methyl orange: bomvu kwi-pH < 3.1, orenji kwi-3.1 ukuya kwi-4.4, mthubi kwi-pH > 4.4
BTB: mthubi kwi-pH < 6.0, luhlaza kwi-6.0 ukuya kwi-7.6, luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwi-pH > 7.6
Phenolphthalein: ayinambala kwi-pH < 8.3, pinki kwi-8.3 ukuya kwi-10.0, bomvu kwi-pH > 10.0
Izisombululo ezintathu zamanzi zemihla ngemihla zavavanywa ngazo zontathu ii-indicator.
(A) Isisombululo somzekelo se-stomach acid: methyl orange bomvu, BTB mthubi, phenolphthalein ayinambala
(B) Isisombululo emva kokongezwa kwe-antacid kwaye yasabela ngokupheleleyo: methyl orange mthubi, BTB mthubi, phenolphthalein ayinambala
(C) Isisombululo esinyibilikisiweyo se-sodium hydrogencarbonate: methyl orange mthubi, BTB luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, phenolphthalein ayinambala
